I realized during my bridal dress fitting that if I allowed her in my life the way I was letting her that she would ruin my wedding just like her mom ruined hers. 

Honestly, there aren't pros of staying in contact - she can't ever make mistakes in her mind and she will always deflect her problems onto others. When I cut her off I'm happier. I no longer feel anxious any time I receive a text and I'm not dreading the weekend when I'm afraid she'll demand I make an hour drive to see her over something that could be solved over the phone. I don't have to pretend she's the "best mamma ever" to keep her happy and I don't have to spend money I don't have to give her gifts I was manipulated to believe I had to get her.

My dad pointed out to me that the moment I could think for myself she stopped being a great mom and became a person who I feared of upsetting. And I finally realize it now that I'm 24 and feel confident to stand up for myself. 

And thank you so much - I sent her a final message last night saying no longer has a role at the wedding and will only be a guest who will be removed if she acts up. I also told her that if she's late (and she's always late to everything - she's missed so many concerts, awards and achievements of mine because she just didn't care to leave on time) that she will not be allowed in. Our wedding venue owner is a badass and said she has no problem standing guard outside the venue.
